title: Type morph
description: One word melting into the next: the letters' outlines (traced from the display face) flow into the next word's letters in a sweep from left to right, splitting and merging as the letter counts differ, with counters opening and closing. The first word grows out of dots. Big and centred; transparent, for brand words, a three-beat promise ('make. shape. move.') or a title.

words.description: The words in order, each morphing into the next.

beat.description: Seconds from one word to the next (0: spread the words over the block's length).

morph.description: Seconds each morph takes (at most 80 % of the beat).

sweep.description: How far the morph travels across the word: 0 morphs every letter at once, higher letters change left to right.

weight.description: Font weight for sans and mono (the display and serif faces have one weight).

style.description: fill: solid letters; outline: stroked outlines only.

color.description: Letter colour: the palette's ink or accent.

max_size.description: Largest font size, px at 1080 (all words share one size, shrunk to fit the safe width).
